title: Legal Admin & PA FTC
description:
Legal Admin & PA - Maternity Cover

Salary: 35k - 40k

Location: Kingston, no parking but very close to all public transport links

Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract 10 to 12 months, possible extension

Working Pattern: Full time, 9am to 5.30pm, finish at 5pm on Fridays - will offer hybrid working after training

Start date: Ideally mid-September for handover

Are you an experienced Legal Administrator or PA with experience of using LEAP legal software?

Our client is seeking an enthusiastic and organised Legal Assistant to cover a very valued team member whilst on maternity leave. If you're looking to contribute to a supportive team in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities:
- Archiving Files: Occasionally manage file archiving to maintain organisation.
- Office Supplies: Handle orders for office supplies to keep everything running smoothly.
- Communication: Answer phone calls and take messages, ensuring clients feel valued and heard.
- Meeting Management: Attend online meetings to take attendance notes and book meetings.
- Billing Support: Assist with billing to ensure timely and accurate invoicing.
- Diary Management: Maintain calendars, diary management for court appearances, and manage court directions and hearings.
- File Management: Oversee general file management on LEAP, including opening new files, compliance checks, and organising correspondence.
- Engagement Letters: Prepare letters of engagement for new clients with precision.
- Searches: Conduct land registry searches and smart searches for new clients to facilitate due diligence.

Additional Duties:
- Prepare applications/forms on the portal, including Forms E.
- Draught cost update letters and assist clients in completing required documentation.
- Review disclosure documents, including bank statements, to ensure thoroughness.
- Attend court or conferences with counsel, taking detailed attendance notes

Why Join?
- Friendly & Supportive Environment: Work with a friendly and professional team dedicated to providing excellent service.
- Professional Growth: Gain valuable experience in the legal field while developing your skills.
- Exciting Challenges: Every day brings new opportunities to learn and grow in your role.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Birchrose Associates is proud to be representing a highly regarded law firm based in London, which is seeking a Legal Secretary to join its property team.

The Firm

Our client, a respected and well-established law firm based in London, is looking for a Legal Secretary to provide high-quality support within its busy Property team.

The Opportunity

The successful Legal Secretary will provide administrative and secretarial support to a team of fee earners within a busy Property team. This is the perfect opportunity for a proactive Junior Legal PA / Secretary looking to take the next step in their career and develop within a highly regarded law firm. Duties to include:
- Provide comprehensive legal secretarial support, including document production, file management, billing, file opening and closing, and general administrative support
- Manage diaries, meetings, travel arrangements, client communications and internal coordination to ensure an efficient service for the team
- Support property transactions by assisting with post-completion matters, including Stamp Duty Land Tax returns, Land Registry applications, notices of transfer and completion payments
- Handle Land Registry processes, responding to requisitions and using the Digital Registration Service
- Assist with commercial and residential property searches and preparing documentation
- Work closely with Partners, Fee Earners, Department EAs and Senior Secretaries
- Provide support with financial processes, including drafting invoices, monitoring WIP and assisting with debt management initiatives

This Legal Secretary position is a full-time, permanent role, working Monday - Friday 9:30am- 5:30pm.

Requirements
- At least a year's administrative experience in a law firm (essential)
- Experience supporting a Property / Real Estate team (desired)

Vacancy Highlights
- Hybrid working
- Competitive benefits package

To be considered for this Legal Secretary opportunity please contact Birchrose Associates for a confidential discussion.

Birchrose Associates, trading name of Huntress Search Ltd, acts as a Recruitment Agency in relation to all Permanent roles and as a Recruitment Business in relation to all Temporary roles.

We practice a diverse and inclusive recruitment process that ensures equal opportunity for all we work with, irrespective of race, sexual orientation, mental or physical disability, age or gender. title: Paralegal
description:

The firm offers opportunities across Patent Litigation, Competition and Technology, Construction and Disputes, providing excellent exposure to sophisticated legal work and the opportunity to develop a strong foundation in a demanding paralegal environment.

The Role
- Supporting legal teams with the coordination and progression of matters.
- Assisting with pre-hearing preparation, including cross-referencing documents and preparing bundles.
- Preparing, organising and maintaining case files.
- Reviewing and analysing key documents for relevance and legal privilege.
- Proofreading legal documentation.
- Conducting document review and assisting with disclosure-related work.
- Liaising with clients, overseas law firms and other representatives.
- Coordinating and participating in international conference calls.
- Taking and drafting meeting minutes.
- Maintaining databases containing privilege information and legal advice.
- Conducting legal research and monitoring external legal databases.
- Providing general support to fee earners and assisting with ad hoc matters as required.

About You
- Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Outstanding attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong organisation and time management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and competing deadlines.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced and demanding legal environment.
- Proactive, self-motivated and keen to develop.
- Strong team player with a collaborative approach.
- Genuine interest in developing a career within a leading specialist law firm.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Paralegal looking to gain high-quality experience across sophisticated litigation and contentious matters, with strong opportunities for professional development and progression.

title: Probate Administrator
description:
Probate Administrator

South Croydon Permanent Full-Time
Salary: Competitive and dependent on experience

We are seeking an experienced and highly organised Probate Administrator to join our busy and growing probate team. This is an excellent opportunity for a knowledgeable probate professional who can hit the ground running and play a key role in supporting the efficient administration of estates.

Due to increasing workload and business demand, we are looking for a committed individual with genuine hands-on probate experience who can manage case files confidently while delivering an excellent client experience.

The Role

As a Probate Administrator, you will be responsible for supporting the administration of estates from initial instruction through to completion. You will work closely with clients, financial institutions, and other third parties to ensure matters are progressed efficiently and accurately.

This role requires someone with practical probate administration experience and the ability to manage their workload independently within a supportive team environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Setting up new probate files and managing case administration from instruction through to completion
- Gathering and collating estate and asset information from financial institutions and third parties
- Preparing probate documentation and applications for submission to the Probate Registry
- Assisting with inheritance tax assessments and related documentation
- Liaising with banks, building societies, investment providers, utility companies, and other organisations
- Maintaining accurate file records and case management systems
- Providing regular updates and support to clients throughout the probate process
- Chasing outstanding information and documentation to ensure cases progress efficiently
- Supporting the team in managing workloads and reducing case backlogs
- Ensuring all work is completed accurately and in accordance with company procedures and relevant regulations

Candidate Requirements
Essential
- Previous experience as a Probate Administrator, Probate Case Handler, Estate Administrator, or in a similar role
- Proven hands-on experience of probate and estate administration
- Strong understanding of the probate process from application through to estate administration
- Experience handling probate applications and estate-related correspondence
- Excellent organisational and administrative skills
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to manage multiple cases and priorities effectively
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail

Desirable
- Experience using Exizent or similar probate case management software
- Knowledge of trusts and charitable legacies
- Experience conducting client onboarding and providing ongoing client updates
- Previous experience within a legal, will-writing, or specialist probate environment

About You

The successful candidate will:
- Have practical, real-world probate experience rather than solely academic knowledge
- Be capable of working independently and taking ownership of their workload
- Be organised, reliable, and committed to delivering high standards of service
- Enjoy working as part of a collaborative and supportive team
- Be looking for a stable, long-term career opportunity

What's on Offer
- Permanent, full-time position
- Competitive salary based on experience
- Supportive and friendly team culture
- Opportunity to further develop your probate expertise
- Long-term career prospects within an established and growing business

Location

South Croydon

This is an office-based role and candidates should be able to commute reliably to the office.

title: Trade Mark Paralegal
description:
A highly regarded law firm is seeking an experienced Trade Mark Paralegal to join its busy Intellectual Property team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Trade Mark Paralegal with at least 2 years' experience to support trade mark attorneys and lawyers across portfolio management, formalities and client matters within a collaborative and forward-thinking environment.

The Trade Mark Paralegal role:
- Managing and updating trade mark portfolios and databases
- Monitoring deadlines and maintaining accurate records
- Preparing and filing UKIPO and WIPO trade mark applications and forms
- Assisting with oppositions, cancellations and recordals
- Managing trade mark and domain name renewals
- Preparing client reports, cost estimates and invoices
- Liaising with clients, overseas attorneys and intellectual property offices
- Assisting with trade mark searches, watching services and portfolio audits
- Supporting global assignments and change of name recordals
- Assisting with evidence collection and general IP administration

The successful Trade Mark Paralegal:
- Minimum 2 years' Trade Mark Paralegal or IP administration experience
- Strong knowledge of trade mark formalities and portfolio management
- Excellent organisation and time management skills
- Exceptional attention to detail
- Experience using trade mark management databases
- WebTMS or IPPO experience would be advantageous
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Proactive, adaptable and able to work under pressure
- CITMA Paralegal Qualification would be advantageous

What's on offer:
- Salary of 26,000 - 30,000
- Opportunity to join a well-established IP team
- Direct exposure to trade mark attorneys and clients
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Ongoing training and development
- Clear opportunities for career progression
